# orbivisor_vm (Resource)

A virtual machine. `state` is `running` or `stopped`. Hardware changes on a running VM hot-plug or apply at the next restart (the plan warns).

Manifest kind `Vm`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orbivisor_vm" "web01" {
  name       = "web01"
  folder     = "/prod/web"
  state      = "running"
  cpu        = { cores = 4 }
  memory_mib = 8192
  machine    = "q35"
  disks      = [{ volume = orbivisor_volume.web01_root.name, bus = "virtio-blk" }]
  nics       = [{ network = orbivisor_network.app.name, model = "virtio", security_groups = [orbivisor_security_group.web.name] }]
  cloud_init = { user = "rocky", ssh_keys = [file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")] }

  # Write-only: sent to the server, never stored in the state. Bump the version to send it again.
  cloud_init_password_wo         = var.web_password
  cloud_init_password_wo_version = 1
}

variable "web_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cpu` (Dynamic) CPU, e.g. `{ cores = 2 }` (sockets, threads, model, flags…).
- `machine` (String) Machine type (`q35`, `virt`…).
- `memory_mib` (Number)
- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `cdroms` (Dynamic) CD-ROMs: list of objects.
- `cloud_init` (Dynamic) cloud-init (user, ssh_keys, …). Give the password with `cloud_init_password_wo`.
- `cloud_init_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) cloud-init password (write-only: never stored in the state). Sent on create and when `cloud_init_password_wo_version` changes. Needs Terraform 1.11+ (tested with OpenTofu 1.13).
- `cloud_init_password_wo_version` (Number) Change it to send `cloud_init_password_wo` again (the value itself is not stored, so Terraform cannot see it change).
- `disks` (Dynamic) Disks: list of `{ volume = "name", bus = "virtio-blk" }`.
- `firmware` (String) `bios` or `uefi`.
- `folder` (String) Folder path (`/prod/web`); empty is the tree's root. Changing it replaces the object (move it with `orbivisorctl folder move` and change the path here instead).
- `guest_agent` (Dynamic)
- `ha` (Dynamic) HA: `true`/`false` or an object.
- `hugepages` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).
- `max_memory_mib` (Number) Memory hot-plug ceiling.
- `nics` (Dynamic) NICs: list of `{ network = "name", model = "virtio", security_groups = [...] }`. The server fills MAC addresses; they are not compared unless declared.
- `numa` (Dynamic)
- `placement` (Dynamic)
- `replication` (Dynamic)
- `restart` (String) Restart policy.
- `secure_boot` (Boolean)
- `snapshot_schedule` (Dynamic)
- `state` (String) Power state: `running` or `stopped` (unset: Terraform does not touch the power).
- `template` (Boolean) The VM is a template.
- `tpm` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By name or by id
terraform import orbivisor_vm.web01 web01
```
